note: HTML diagrams for tutorials. Labels and captions must describe documented v0.5.7 behavior; sources name the public guides or release notes.

model-placement.title: Where each part runs
model-placement.caption: Clio Coder, its tools, and inference can run in different places. Choosing a remote model does not move your files or tools there.

stages.label: Clio Coder and its tools
stages.body: The session, repository tools, and approvals run where you start Clio Coder.

stages.label: Inference
stages.body: A local app, a model server, a subscription, or a provider API.

stages.label: Worker tools
stages.body: On this computer by default, or on an SSH node you configure.

context-controls.title: Four controls for a long task
context-controls.caption: Inspect first; reduce, hand off, or recover only for a stated reason.

stages.label: Inspect
stages.body: Usage, reserved output, remaining headroom, and any pending handoff.

stages.label: Reduce
stages.body: A focused summary that keeps what you name.

stages.label: Hand off
stages.body: A continuation bound to this branch and its decisions.

stages.label: Recover
stages.body: Reduce or deliver, chosen explicitly by its ID.

check-freshness.title: When a passing check still counts
check-freshness.caption: A recorded result belongs to the inputs it ran against; an edit to those inputs makes it stale until the check runs again.

stages.label: Declared check
stages.body: A package script, build target, or CI definition the project already owns.

stages.label: Recorded pass
stages.body: Stored with source, check-declaration, and policy fingerprints.

stages.label: Stale
stages.body: The earlier pass no longer describes the files.

stages.label: Current
stages.body: A result for the work that exists now.

library-flow.title: From the catalog to one task
library-flow.caption: Installing a package makes it available; a task loads what it needs. Neither step grants extra authority.

stages.label: Browse
stages.body: Catalog content that ships with Clio Coder; nothing is installed yet.

stages.label: Preview
stages.body: Destination, dependencies, scope, and the package pin.

stages.label: Pinned copy
stages.body: Drifted content is blocked from loading.

remote-placement.title: One remote task
remote-placement.caption: The conversation stays on your laptop, the worker runs its tools on the node, and the worker's model route resolves from the node.

stages.label: Session
stages.body: The conversation, your approvals, and the dispatch.

stages.label: Worker
stages.body: Runs at default authority in the same absolute project path.

stages.label: Inference
stages.body: A localhost address resolves on the node, not on your laptop.
